knowledge_cards.claim: Open hybrid ER/STFT implementation does not prove perceptual quality, naturalness or mix improvement.
Block size jointly changes spectral resolution, tonal/noise character, temporal smearing and latency.
ERs can precede and bridge a delayed tail but do not remove N/(2*fs) tail latency or the minimum tail-delay constraint.
pre_delay seeds the ER PRNG, so changing it also changes the later tap pattern.
Width can reach anti-correlated/side-only tails and also spreads ER taps; mono/downmix and correlation checks are mandatory.
link changes inter-channel envelope coupling independently of noise correlation; do not vary link and width together in attribution tests.
Shift/drift are linear-bin operations and create inharmonic tails; they are creative effects, not transparent modulation.
v1.0 and v1.1.0 are one lineage; version drift requires separate paper-parity and deployment manifests.
One REAPER/M2 Pro CPU reading is not target-host, multi-instance or deadline evidence.
No discovered automated tests/CI and no executed parity check mean repository presence is not reproduction.
